author: Mark Atwood
text: Confidence: ~75% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: (a) #[serde(tag = "@type")] + #[serde(flatten)] interaction for ChatMessagePush — flagged as JMAP-ly0n.6 — I could not verify behavior without running a probe, which the read-only review rules forbid. (b) Clearable null-clears for nested Vec types (permission_overrides: Option<Clearable<Vec<ChannelPermission>>>) — the serde path is plausible but only tested via 'matches!(Set(_))' rather than a verbatim Vec equality assertion. Uncertainty driven by: serde's flatten + tag interaction has historical quirks I could not exercise here. Would raise confidence if: (1) the read-only review allowed running cargo test to confirm all current tests still pass at HEAD, (2) JMAP-ly0n.6's added negative assertions were folded into the existing tests, and (3) a probe for ChatContact.id with the literal value 'self' confirmed the SenderId collision.
